description: CRLF line ends, skipped sections and a comment, hit objects out of order. x 64, 192, 320, 448 are lanes 0 to 3; x 128 is exactly lane 1; x 600 and -20 clamp to lanes 3 and 0. Type 5 is a note with the new-combo bit. A hold ending before its start (1750, end 1700) and one without an end field (2250) are zero-length holds. The title prefers TitleUnicode; there is no ArtistUnicode.
